paragraphs.text: Sedouris was a city on the continent of Corondor on the plane of Dominaria .

The dark planeswalker Geyadrone Dihada summoned a powerful Cosmic Horror to sack the city of Sedouris after Sol'Kanar the Swamp King had held the city under siege for five years. Afterward, Dihada installed her walking citadel in the dome of Sedouris. When Carth summoned Dakkon Blackblade at the site of the city, Dihada revealed herself, her giant crab-leg citadel ripping Sedouris apart.
